description: This Java source file defines the KeyStoreUtil class, providing utility methods for handling keystores, certificates, and cryptographic operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: KeyStoreUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for keystore management, certificate handling, and cryptographic operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: storeComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Stores a KeyStore object to a file associated with a specific component and keystore name.

methods.name: getComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Retrieves a KeyStore for a specific component and keystore name.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Loads a KeyStore from a URL with specified password and type.

methods.name: getSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Loads the system's default trust store, typically used for SSL/TLS operations.

methods.name: readCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a byte array.

methods.name: getCertX500Map
methods.description: Returns a map of the subject's X.500 distinguished name components from a certificate.

methods.name: getX500Map
methods.description: Parses an X500Principal into a map of its components.

methods.name: importPKCS8CertChain
methods.description: Imports a private key and certificate chain into a keystore under a specified alias.

methods.name: certToString
methods.description: Converts a Certificate object into a PEM-formatted string.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Parses a PEM-formatted certificate string or file into a Certificate object.

methods.name: pemToPkHex
methods.description: Extracts the public key from a PEM certificate and returns it as a hex string.
